split_rule: union source groups sharing crop PNG SHA256 or full-panel pixel SHA256; sort components by SHA256(domain|sorted source IDs); add whole components until ceil(20 percent of all admitted positive crops) are assigned to validation
fit_selection_rule: maximize fit F1; tie by greater precision, then higher threshold
material_gain_rule: on validation, require at least 20 percent fewer false-positive crop candidates than scanner-only and no more than 5 percentage points loss in positive-crop recall
